svg.text: SROT starter kit: breadboard build (1 flow sensor)
The ESP32 sits below the breadboard (too wide to plug in). Connect its pins with male-to-female jumpers.
ESP32 DevKitC (38-pin), lying flat, USB port on the left
These pins are on the edge nearest the breadboard
Flow sensor 1 (IN): yellow → b3, red → + rail row 1, black → − rail row 2
Push male-to-male jumpers into each flow sensor's 3-pin plug to reach the breadboard.
Check every connection before powering on. Plug in the power bank last.
